text:
Anya (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — planning a mentor swap + open-lab week for the new SI cohort (to accelerate shadowing and hands-on certs). Draft schedule and asks below. Can mentors/proctors confirm availability?

Matt G (SI): I can cover Mon/Tue mornings (PST). Need access to the hw sandbox for 2 mentees at a time.

Devon S (Enablement): Thanks — confirmed for Wed afternoon and Thu morning. I can run the proctor checklist and the intro walk-through.

Sophie (Ops): Noted. Can we get the infra access tickets created by EOD so VPN/KMS is ready? Also cc-ing infra team.

Anya (Partnerships): Yes — infra tickets below. @Sophie can you create invites for mentors and include the lab playbook link? Also need 2 backup mentors for overlap.

OnboardBot: New access ticket created: TKT-4521 (sandbox gpu provisioning). ETA: 48 hours.

Matt G (SI): I added two volunteer mentors: @Ravi and @Hannah. They can take Thurs afternoon and Fri AM.

Devon S (Enablement): Uploading the proctor checklist now — please use this condensed run-through in the lab:```
Day 0: Account + VPN check (15m)
Day 1: Model deploy demo (45m)
Day 2: Quantization + perf microbench (60m)
Day 3: Failure scenarios + fallback test (30m)
Day 4: Certification exercise (90m)```

Sophie (Ops): Calendar invites sent to mentors + SI cohort. I attached the access SOP and hardware labeling map.

Anya (Partnerships): A few quick asks: 1) Mentors: please record one short clip of your deploy demo (<= 7m). 2) Enablement: can you add a section on proctor grading policy to the playbook? 3) Partnerships: I'll draft the partner notification email.

Devon S (Enablement): Will add the grading rubric. Suggest pass/fail + one remediation session.

Matt G (SI): One logistic — can we reserve an extra NVMe node for the cert exercise to avoid noisy neighbors? Ops, possible?

Sophie (Ops): Reserving NVMe node NVME-07 for Fri cert window. Noted on noisy neighbor risk; will monitor.

Anya (Partnerships): Great. Last item: joint announcement planning — want a short blog + partner highlight after the cohort completes. Matt, can you draft 3 bullets about SI outcomes we can quote?

Matt G (SI): Sure — will drop bullets by Tue.

OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: send pre-lab checklist to cohort 48 hours before Day 0.

Anya (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. If no blockers, we’re green to run this cohort next month. Ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
